entries.label: Renegade — NECA Series13 2015
entries.sourceEdition: NECA Series13 Renegade2015 retail catalogue edition, source-view only
entries.prompt:
Create version A: one faithfully isolated detachable rigid mask from the attached OFFICIAL NECA Series13 Renegade2015 retail catalogue photograph. Use ONLY the mask worn by the green figure near the upper center of this photo. Preserve this photographed retail edition, its actual almost-frontal camera with slight downward pitch, all visible sculpture and muted dark gray/violet paint. Do not replace it with a generic mask, a film prop, a different Renegade depiction or the brown/white-mask photo-comic version.
The actual rigid silhouette in this source is compact and nearly square, roughly0.95–1.0 as wide as it is high, with a broad low rounded crown and a SHORT BLUNT lower face. Do not generate a long narrow mouth, a tall forehead or a pointed chin. Keep the raised shallow oval/curved crown panel and rim seam, its sloping brow, the narrow optical band with the actual small pale silver/gray lens highlights, the short broad center nose plate, angular cheek transitions and rounded squared-off short lower edge. Preserve the source's little side housings and exactly THREE small red points on the image-left temple fitting, in their photographed arrangement. No fourth/fifth lens, no new central ornament, glyph, forehead scar, rune, teeth, horn, skull, mouth grill or vent pattern. Keep the fine details subdued at the photographed resolution rather than inventing new sharp mechanisms.
Remove ALL wearer anatomy and surroundings: green skin, eyes/face, chin/mandibles, dreadlocks with bands, neck and black neck covering, shoulder cannon, armor, body, hands, axe, guns, white backdrop, shadow and stand. Retain only the rigid helmet and integral fittings. The dark eye band and its pale lens highlights are opaque lens/recess surfaces, not a new empty mouth or open eye holes. Do not reconstruct hidden back, interior or an unseen side. Preserve source asymmetries and the subtle downward camera rather than symmetrizing the shape.
A retains the subdued photographed gray-purple cast/paint and soft catalogue lighting, without bronze, white bone, brown paint, added glow, polished chrome or dramatic new reflections. One single complete isolated mask in its source view on genuine transparent alpha, centered with10–12percent clear margins around its whole silhouette, no clipping, scene, floor, shadow plane, text, labels, watermarks or comparison grid. Native square1254x1254 if available. This is a source-bound licensed retail-edition study with limited fine-detail resolution, not certification of original franchise geometry.
entries.camera: Nearly frontal, slight downward source camera; not physically calibrated.
limitations: Specific2015 retail edition, not automatic film prop or original Kenner mesh certification.
Mask occupies roughly133x147 pixels in the992x1300 catalogue photo; fine paint pores, tiny lens spacing and edges remain interpreted.
Slight frontal balancing and material lighting are uncalibrated; hidden back, inside and other viewpoints are not provided.
Brown/white depiction from the separate photographic mini-comic is not used as this retail palette.

notes: Compact muzzle, shallow oval crown panel, opaque pale optics and exactly three red image-left temple points retained.
No body, skin, dreads, neck covering, weapons or caster retained.
B changes restrained materials/light and keeps the same source camera and visible design.

entries.prompt:
Create version B of the single isolated NECA Renegade Series13 2015 mask in reference1. Reference2 is the unchanged official retail catalogue photograph. Preserve the sculpture, complete silhouette, relative feature placement and almost-frontal/slightly downward camera of reference1. The correct source-view mask is compact, around0.89–0.91 as wide as high after excluding dreadlocks; reference1 matches this. Keep that ratio and every relative panel dimension. Do not widen the crown, lengthen the lower snout, move the eyes, change the brow curve, invent perspective or turn it into a generic Jungle Hunter film prop.
Preserve the low rounded crown and its shallow oval raised panel/rim seam, sloped brow, dark optic band with the same PALE OPAQUE lens highlights, short broad nasal plate, angular cheeks and blunt rounded squared lower edge. Exactly THREE red lens points on the image-left temple fitting, in the same little triangle: no extra points, different arrangement or large emitted glow. Keep the original small side housings and source asymmetries. No new runes, scars, glyphs, vents, teeth, horns, mouth grill, fittings or ornaments. The dark optic band is not to be punched through to transparency.
Change only the material/light presentation to the project's coherent Predator:Hunting Grounds equipment quality: restrained upper-left key, soft frontal fill, believable dark gray gunmetal with its subtle source purple cast, finer subdued metallic micrograin instead of amplified toy-paint pores, clear existing bevels and controlled highlights. Keep the photographed muted gray-purple palette and existing surface character; no bronze/brown/white paint, chrome polish, new cracks, recolored eyes, new damage or theatrical colored reflections. Do not borrow the brown/white mask appearance from a different photo-comic depiction.
Only the rigid detachable mask on genuine transparent exterior alpha, with no green wearer skin, head, dreadlocks, mandibles, neck covering, body, weapons, cannon, stand or scenery. No invented back/interior or hidden side. One complete mask only, centered with8–12percent clear margin and no clipping, floor, shadow plane, labels, border, text, grid or checkerboard. Native square1254 if supported. B remains an unvalidated source-bound study of this exact retail edition; the PHG-style light does not certify canonical franchise geometry.
